title: Native toolchain calls recompile per invocation with no warm reuse

minimal_reproducer.command: time mncs call native/mncs/debug/debug.mncs decide --args '{}' (twice in a row)

expected_semantics: Repeated native evaluations of an unchanged module reuse compiled artifacts or a resident evaluator, so the second identical call is cheap.
actual_behavior_limitation: Each native call pays the full compile (~10s quiet, ~70s under family load) with no observed warm reuse; a record costs one observe (~ms) plus one native compile, and every sufficiency/diagnosis call pays again.
why_capability_matters: Interactive-rate debugging needs sub-second repeated questions; per-call recompilation makes every native question expensive and load-sensitive (10s to 70s observed).
current_workaround: Resident sessions memoize native decisions by request identity (11.2s cold to 0.13s warm measured back-to-back); cold questions still pay full compile.

host_language_code_required.why: The memo is launcher-side content addressing over immutable witnesses; it cannot warm the toolchain itself.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: A toolchain artifact cache with documented invalidation, or a resident native evaluation service the debugger can bind to, keyed by module interface identity.
resolution_criteria: Two consecutive identical native calls show documented warm reuse, or a resident evaluation contract exists that the debugger can adopt.
